original_test_intent: Validate the Type 38 IPMI Specification Revision as a valid BCD-encoded design revision for the referenced BMC interface, consistent with the approved platform expectation and stable after reboot.
original_method: Collect complete raw/decoded Type 38 with length and record identity, extract the revision byte, validate both BCD nibbles and decode major/minor, compare with the approved SMBIOS design baseline and optional read-only controller evidence, then repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user defines the authoritative expected revision/comparison source and approves reboot; raw parsing and read-only comparison are software actions.
required_inputs: Expected IPMI specification/design revision for this BMC
Policy distinguishing SMBIOS design revision from controller-presented version
SMBIOS version, Type 38 length and raw decoder
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/BMC/IPMI queries; never flash or reconfigure the controller.
Preserve raw revision byte and reject non-decimal BCD nibbles before decoding.
Do not equate unrelated firmware version strings with IPMI Specification Revision.
Require reboot approval/recovery; stop on management loss, invalid BCD or unexplained identity mismatch and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate record length, decode raw BCD revision, compare the approved baseline and optional correlated controller evidence, and diff pre/post reboot.
Report invalid BCD, ambiguous record, baseline mismatch or drift without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected revision and authoritative comparison source plus reboot plan.
Interpret legitimate presentation differences and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field label is relevant, but grep cannot prove raw BCD, offset/length, record identity or the intended comparison source.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 38; report handle/length, raw revision byte, BCD-nibble validity, decoded revision, approved baseline, optional controller corroboration and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The IPMI revision scope, Type 38 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no firmware action is added.

modernized_recommendation.status: RAW BCD AND IDENTITY-CORRELATED REVISION VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Length-validate Type 38, parse the raw revision byte as BCD, compare the decoded design revision with an approved source and only correlated controller evidence, then repeat after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems publishing SMBIOS Type 38 IPMI Device Information.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, decoder/dmidecode and optional IPMI tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 38 IPMI Specification Revision encoding and platform BMC design baseline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds byte-level BCD validity, comparison-source identity and persistence evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects invalid nibbles, wrong version-domain comparison and record ambiguity hidden by formatted text.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected design revision and authoritative comparison policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Controller firmware version and supported IPMI spec may be displayed differently; only like-for-like fields should be compared.

project_override_considerations: A project may choose SMBIOS design data, a correlated controller spec value or both as comparison sources, but must not substitute a general BMC firmware version string.
expected_evidence: Approved expected IPMI design revision and comparison-source policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 38 with handle/length and revision byte
BCD-nibble validation, decoded revision and optional correlated controller evidence
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot byte/semantic diff
Any invalid BCD, record ambiguity or domain mismatch preserved

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: IPMI Specification Revision is a defined Type 38 BCD field; the authoritative expected value is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: BCD validation, comparison and persistence checks are fully automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw BCD, length/identity and correct version-domain comparison.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains BMC safety and comparison nuance while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates missing baseline/reboot readiness and engineer verdict from automation.

review_improvement: Prevents a human-readable revision from passing when derived from invalid BCD or compared against an unrelated firmware version.
independent_technical_reasoning: Raw BCD validation and like-for-like evidence comparison are deterministic software work; owner input selects the baseline without making the core manual.
